note: Triennial election of the sixteen district electoral divisions of Hillsborough rural district, one member each, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. Two contests, Carryduff and Ballymacbrennan; thirteen members returned unopposed; no nomination for Dromara, whose retiring member was deemed re-elected (returning officer's notice of result, Lisburn Herald, 11 June 1955, p. 2; round 2, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
